# Job-scam company list

> Records of companies and domains that public sources named in job-seeker fraud, plus 34 employers that Reverse Recruiting Agency (RRA) skips because of the business model. One record per entity.

## Files

- data/companies.jsonl: one JSON object per line. Load this file first.
- data/companies.csv: the canonical file, same records.
- data/companies.sqlite: table `companies`, indexes on `domain` and `name_normalized`.
- data/ats_hosts.jsonl: allowlist of known ATS and job board hosts ({host, type}). A match on the host or a parent domain means a real hiring platform. It does not prove that the job is real.
- data/lookalike_domains.csv: fake domains that copy a real business ({impersonated_business, lookalike_domain, source}). The impersonated business is the victim.
- data/dol_debarred_employers.csv: employers that the US Department of Labor debarred from a visa labor program, copied from dol.gov on 2026-11-21. Real businesses, not scam operations. Check dol.gov for the current status.
- data/staffing_wage_violations.csv: staffing and placement firms with back-wage findings of $10,000 or more since 2015, filtered from US Department of Labor enforcement data. Real businesses, not scam operations.
- schema/company.schema.json: JSON Schema for one record.
- README.md: field meanings, categories, method, limits.

## How to use a record

- To check a company, match the `domain` first. If there is no domain, match `name_normalized` (lower case, letters and digits only).
- Obey `match_on`. When it is `domain`, match the domain only. `name_claimed` is the name the operation used. It can belong to a real business that the operation copied. Never match on `name_claimed`.
- Never flag the business in `impersonates`. It is the victim.
- A match means "a source named this entity". Say that, and give `source_type`, `source_date`, and `source_url`. Do not say that the entity is a scam.
- `evidence_level` = `rra_internal` means an employer that RRA skips because of the business model (multi-level marketing, insurance agency recruiting, commission-only direct sales). There is no outside source. RRA makes no claim of wrongdoing. Do not describe these records as fraud.
- No match does not mean that a company is safe.

## How to cite

"Named in a [source_type] source dated [source_date]: [source_url] (Job-scam company list, Reverse Recruiting Agency)."
